description: Power and thermals from prometheus-ipmi-exporter. Power: ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts (preferred) or ipmi_power_watts. Temp: ipmi_temperature_celsius. If temperatures work but power is empty: DCMI collector may be OK while BMC lacks Power Measurement — exporter then omits the watts metric (since 1.7). Chassis power state still shows on/off. Filters: up{exporter="ipmi"}.

panels.description: Sum of IPMI power watts. Prefer ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts; else ipmi_power_watts. No data means BMC did not export a watts metric (common when DCMI Power Measurement is unsupported — see exporter 1.7+).

targets.expr: sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: Current Total Power

panels.description: Average of per-host IPMI chassis/sensor power among hosts currently reporting.

targets.expr: avg(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: Average Power per Reporting Node

panels.description: Max of total IPMI chassis/sensor power over the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: Peak Total Power in Selected Range

panels.description: Distinct hostnames with DCMI or IPMI power sensor readings for current filters.

targets.expr: count(count by (hostname) (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nodes Reporting Power

panels.description: Current IPMI chassis/sensor power aggregated by Luna group.

targets.expr: (sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: Power per Luna Group

panels.description: Watts and share of measured IPMI power total per Luna group.

targets.expr: (sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

(sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) / clamp_min(scalar(sum(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))), 1e-9)

panels.title: Power by Group (watts and share)

panels.description: IPMI chassis/sensor power by Luna group over the selected range.

targets.expr: (sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: Power by Luna Group over Time

panels.description: Highest-consuming ~10% of hosts currently reporting IPMI power (at least 1).

targets.expr: topk(scalar(clamp_min(ceil(count(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) * 0.1), 1)), (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})))

panels.title: Top 10% Nodes by Power

panels.description: Per-host IPMI power (DCMI preferred, else power sensors).

targets.expr: (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: Nodes with Power Series

panels.description: Per-host IPMI power over time for selected filters.

targets.expr: (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: Selected Node Power over Time

panels.description: Max of IPMI CPU temperature sensors (ipmi_temperature_celsius name~CPU*Temp).

targets.expr: max(max by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_temperature_celsius{name=~"[cC][pP][uU].*[tT][eE][mM][pP].*",luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: Max CPU Temp

panels.description: Max of IPMI inlet/system temperature sensors.

targets.expr: max(max by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_temperature_celsius{name=~"([Ii]nlet|[Ss]ys).*[tT][eE][mM]?[pP].*",luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: Max Inlet/System Temp

panels.description: Highest single-host max across all IPMI temperature sensors.

targets.expr: max(max by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_temperature_celsius{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: Hottest Node (any sensor)

panels.description: Distinct hostnames with any ipmi_temperature_celsius sample.

targets.expr: count(count by (hostname) (ipmi_temperature_celsius{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nodes Reporting Temp

panels.description: Highest CPU temperatures from IPMI sensors.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_temperature_celsius{name=~"[cC][pP][uU].*[tT][eE][mM][pP].*",luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: Top Nodes by CPU Temp

panels.description: Per-host max CPU and inlet/system IPMI temperatures.

targets.expr: max by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_temperature_celsius{name=~"[cC][pP][uU].*[tT][eE][mM][pP].*",luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})
max by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_temperature_celsius{name=~"([Ii]nlet|[Ss]ys).*[tT][eE][mM]?[pP].*",luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})

panels.title: Node Temperatures

panels.description: Per-host max CPU IPMI temperature over the selected range.

targets.expr: max by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_temperature_celsius{name=~"[cC][pP][uU].*[tT][eE][mM][pP].*",luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})

panels.title: CPU Temp over Time

panels.description: Configured prometheus-ipmi-exporter scrape targets (up{exporter="ipmi"}).

targets.expr: count(count by (hostname) (up{exporter="ipmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: IPMI Targets Expected

panels.description: IPMI scrape targets currently healthy (up==1).

targets.expr: count(count by (hostname) (up{exporter="ipmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: IPMI Targets Up

panels.description: Hosts with ipmi_up{collector="dcmi"}==1 (required for DCMI watts).

targets.expr: count(count by (hostname) (ipmi_up{collector="dcmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: DCMI Collectors OK

panels.description: Hosts with any IPMI power reading / IPMI targets expected.

targets.expr: (count(count by (hostname) (sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((count(count by (hostname) (up{exporter="ipmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Power Coverage

panels.description: 0=No watts metric; 1=watts all 0; 2=non-zero watts; 3=DCMI collector OK but BMC exported no watts (Power Measurement unsupported).

targets.expr: (clamp_max(count((sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) > 0), 1) * 2) or clamp_max(count(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})), 1) or (clamp_max(count(ipmi_up{collector="dcmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} == 1), 1) * 3) or vector(0)

panels.title: Power Series Status

panels.description: Per-host IPMI scrape, DCMI collector health, chassis power state, and watts. DCMI=ok with Power=No series means BMC has no Power Measurement (exporter does not export ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts).

targets.expr: max by (luna_group, hostname) (up{exporter="ipmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})
max by (luna_group, hostname) (ipmi_up{collector="dcmi", luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})
max by (luna_group, hostname) (ipmi_chassis_power_state{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})

(sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or sum by (hostname, luna_group) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

panels.title: IPMI Power Coverage

panels.description: Hosts with ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts. 0 while DCMI OK means Power Measurement unsupported.

targets.expr: count(count by (hostname) (ipmi_dcmi_power_consumption_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: DCMI Watts Series

panels.description: Hosts with ipmi_power_watts sensor readings (fallback when DCMI watts missing).

targets.expr: count(count by (hostname) (ipmi_power_watts{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Sensor Watts Series

panels.description: Hosts with ipmi_chassis_power_state==1 (on). Shows even when watts metrics are absent.

targets.expr: count(count by (hostname) (ipmi_chassis_power_state{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Chassis Powered On

panels.description: Chassis power on/off from IPMI chassis collector. Useful when DCMI/sensor watts are unavailable.

targets.expr: max by (hostname) (ipmi_chassis_power_state{luna_group=~"$luna_group", hostname=~"$hostname"})
